notes:
kr8 0.4.7 — three canvas fixes from your reports.

- Resizing a box keeps it where it was. It no longer jumps to the top-left of the board or the frame.
- Drawing with the pen no longer selects the stroke afterwards: the pen stays the pen, and the select tool picks a stroke when you want one.
- Place a frame or shape by dragging it out: with a tool picked, press and drag to size it from where you pressed. Shift keeps it square, Alt grows it from the centre. A plain click still places the default size.

Not in this update yet: live boards on the phone, and the move of kr8's downloads to kr8.app.
